lanes.name: Privileged finance applications
lanes.narrative: Finance apps combine privileged access, stale exceptions, and incomplete evidence in one board-visible control lane.
lanes.nextAction: Freeze new exceptions, require MFA closure, and recertify privileged finance groups before month-end close.

lanes.name: Customer data workbench
lanes.narrative: Dormant access and group sprawl create avoidable exposure around customer data tooling.
lanes.nextAction: Remove dormant users, consolidate high-risk groups, and attach access evidence to each policy.

lanes.name: Contractor access boundary
lanes.narrative: Contractor policy is manageable but stale exceptions need explicit expiry and owner review.
lanes.nextAction: Add expiry dates to contractor exceptions and publish owner review status weekly.

lanes.name: Engineering SaaS access
lanes.narrative: Engineering SaaS access is inside tolerance and mainly needs freshness monitoring.
lanes.nextAction: Keep MFA coverage above 90 percent and retire stale engineering exceptions before quarterly review.
